title: phy_model_behavior_ir
description: GENERATED artifact: dv_harness/phy_model_behavior_ir.py extracts PHY architecture facts (training/link-startup flow stage names, TX/RX capability statements, power-state names) from a real PHY specification/model document that has already been offline-distilled by dv_harness.vip_user_guide_distill.distill_user_guide() into a .reference.json + .fulltext.txt pair -- this module never opens a raw PDF itself. Every item carries a real document+line citation; nothing is invented from protocol knowledge. `boundary_context` optionally carries dv_harness.phy_boundary.py's own serial/parallel bind-location decision when the caller supplies one, so the structural (RTL-derived) and the documentary (spec-derived) PHY facts sit in one artifact. `disclosure` is always present and always states that nothing here proves analog/electrical (silicon) correctness -- a digital PHY model and spec prose are architectural descriptions, not a measurement of a real PHY implementation.

status.description: EXTRACTED when a real PHY spec/model reference record (and its full-text extract) was read. NOT_AVAILABLE (with a real `reason`) when no PHY document was supplied, or the supplied record/full-text could not be read -- never a fabricated fact.

disclosure.description: Fixed standing disclaimer: PHY MODEL BEHAVIOR IS NOT SILICON. Present on every document, EXTRACTED or NOT_AVAILABLE alike.

source.description: null only when status is NOT_AVAILABLE because no document was supplied at all.

fulltext_sha256_verified.description: True when the full-text file's current sha256 matches the value the distiller recorded at distillation time; false on a mismatch (the file changed since distillation); null when not applicable.

line.description: 1-based line number in the real full-text extract file -- a reader can open that exact file and line to verify the fact.

evidence_text.description: Literal (possibly truncated) text of the cited line -- never paraphrased or invented.

available.description: True only when a real phy_boundary.json-shaped document (dv_harness.phy_boundary.extract_phy_boundary()'s own output) was supplied and passed its own schema validation. False does not mean the boundary is bad; it means none was supplied to this extraction, or what was supplied did not validate.

boundary_status.description: The supplied phy_boundary document's own top-level `status` (EXTRACTED/NOT_AVAILABLE), carried through verbatim.

classification_kind.description: The supplied document's own classification.kind (SERIAL/PARALLEL/MIXED/UNDECIDABLE), carried through verbatim.
